written_while: the 256-episode run was already in progress (background task by4qlbt4x); no episode result of any kind had been read or computed at the time this was written -- verifiable against the run's own timestamped log.
raised_by: PI review of the frozen spec.

THE_AMBIGUITY_BEING_CLOSED.as_written: branch 4 fires when 'the fresh FULL condition itself fails to reproduce the Pole-A gap', with no numeric criterion for 'fails to reproduce'.
THE_AMBIGUITY_BEING_CLOSED.why_that_is_dangerous_unclosed: n=64 (this ablation) is half of n=128 (the sealed crossover), so delta_A_full's confidence interval is EXPECTED to be wider than the sealed result's -- roughly +-0.15 vs +-0.11 by naive sqrt(2) scaling. If 'reproduce' is read as 'the 95% interval must clear zero again', a wider-but-still-centered-near-0.35 estimate whose CI merely touches zero from reduced power alone could be misclassified as a replication failure (branch 4) when it is not one. Left unclosed, this is exactly the kind of ambiguity that gets resolved after the number is seen -- which this project's own standing rule forbids.

CRITERION_FROZEN_NOW_BEFORE_THE_RESULT_I.branch_4_fires_on_the_POINT_ESTIMATE_onl: delta_A_full's MEAN, not its confidence interval, decides branch 4. A wide CI that merely crosses zero because n=64 has less power than n=128 is NOT by itself a branch-4 trigger.

concrete_thresholds.reproduces (branch 1/2/3 remain live): delta_A_full mean >= 0.20 (comparable in sign and rough magnitude to the sealed +0.352 -- retains at least ~57% of the original effect)
concrete_thresholds.branch_4_fires: delta_A_full mean < 0.10, OR delta_A_full mean is negative (a sign reversal)
concrete_thresholds.ambiguous_zone (0.10 <= mean < 0.20): report as-is with an explicit note that reproduction is marginal; do NOT force it into branch 1/2/3 OR branch 4 -- state the ambiguity and treat any C_A/L_A/L_B reading from this run as provisional pending a wider-n replication, rather than picking whichever branch the rest of the story prefers.

CRITERION_FROZEN_NOW_BEFORE_THE_RESULT_I.why_these_specific_numbers: 0.20 and 0.10 are chosen NOW, before any data exists, specifically so they cannot be tuned after the fact to produce a preferred branch. 0.20 retains the correct SIGN and more than half the original magnitude -- compatible with the sealed estimate under reasonable sampling variation at n=64. Below 0.10 the effect has collapsed to a small fraction of what was sealed, which is a materially different claim regardless of CI width.

WHAT_DOES_NOT_CHANGE: C_A, L_A, L_B and their bootstrap CIs are still the primary quantities for judging H1 once reproduction is established or the ambiguous-zone caveat is applied.
no change to the experiment's design, seeds, checkpoints, or statistics -- this amendment touches ONLY the interpretation criterion for branch 4.
